sources.title: Zoe Build Guides :: League of Legends Strategy Builds, Runes, Items, and Abilities :: Patch 26.19

passive.name: More Sparkles!
passive.text: Zoe's next basic attack after casting a spell deals bonus magic damage.

spells.name: Paddle Star!
spells.text: Zoe fires a missile that she can redirect in flight. Deals more damage the longer it flies in a straight line.

spells.name: Spell Thief
spells.text: Zoe can pick up the remnants of enemy summoner spell and active item casts and cast them once herself. Whenever she casts a summoner spell, she gains 3 missiles that fire at the nearest target.

spells.name: Sleepy Trouble Bubble
spells.text: Causes the target to become drowsy, then fall asleep. While asleep, the target's Magic Resist is reduced. The first source of damage that breaks the sleep is doubled, up to a cap.

spells.name: Portal Jump
spells.text: Blink to a nearby position for 1 second. Then blink back.

damage.value: Zoe deals burst magic damage through Paddle Star! and her empowered attack.

archetype.value: Zoe can play as an assassin, as described by a listed Zoe guide.

axis.value: Zoe can poke with Paddle Star!, which deals more damage the farther it travels.

spikes.why: Zoe gains more listed damage and a shorter cooldown as she ranks up Paddle Star!.
Zoe can fire it more often than at its 8.5-second cooldown.

mistakes.value: Zoe loses Paddle Star! damage by giving it too little straight-line flight.
